description_en: Queries products by tag with paging
description_zh: 调用该接口根据标签分页查询产品列表
kebab_example: aliyun iot list-product-by-tags --product-tag TagKey=room TagValue=102 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListProductByTags

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this value exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
If <props="intl"><ph>the Overview page or </ph></props>this value does not exist, you do not need to specify it.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
